messages:
Iris Chen: Quick design review — noticed a couple of issues in the component library: primary button focus ring is barely visible on the dark nav background, and the small button padding feels oversized in dense tables. Also toasts are disappearing too fast for keyboard users. Can we do a short pass? :eyes:
Samir Patel: On it. I opened a draft PR with a few tweaks (WIP): increased focus ring weight and added new spacing tokens. Will push a diff once CI passes.
Samir Patel: Code snippet in the PR for token proposals:
```css
:root {
  --spacing-compact: 8px; /* new: for dense table rows */
  --spacing-sm: 12px;
  --btn-padding-sm: 6px 12px; /* compact */
  --focus-ring-width: 3px;
  --focus-ring-color: var(--color-focus);
}
```
Marta Ruiz: Accessibility nits: 1) focus ring increase is good but confirm contrast of focus ring (needs enough contrast against bg). 2) Toasts: 3s is too short; suggest 6s default or require action for non-transient messages. 3) Ensure toasts use `aria-live="polite"` and are focusable when keyboard-triggered.
DesignBot: accessibility-checker: contrast-check failed on `button--primary` text/bg ratio 3.9:1 (needs 4.5:1). Suggest swapping `--color-primary` to #0f2b66 or increasing text weight.
Leo Grant: For the dense table use-case (routes list), tighter horizontal padding helps. Current `16px` -> `12px` reduces width and keeps CTA tappable. Also let's add `row-height-compact: 32px` token.
Iris Chen: Agreed on compact tokens. Proposal: spacing-compact = 8px, row-height-compact = 32px, btn-padding-compact = 6px 12px. For focus: use `box-shadow` focus ring at 3px with color token and a subtle outline fallback. I'll update the Figma components and spec doc. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/redwood-design-system (WIP) :pencil2:
Samir Patel: I'll adjust the CSS vars and put fallback for older browsers. Also will add an automatic toast duration override option in the API: `toast({ message, durationMs?: number | 'persistent' })` so we can keep defaults but let callers mark persistent toasts.
Marta Ruiz: Small UX/copy nit — confirm dialog copy: we use "Confirm" vs "Save" inconsistently. For destructive actions use "Confirm" + explain consequence; for state change use "Save". Also modal close button should be first focusable element for dialog keyboard users.
Iris Chen: Good call. I'll standardize the button labels in the spec and add accessibility checklist: focus order, aria-labels, aria-modal, role=dialog, close button focus. I'll ping Claire for copy sign-off once updated.
Samir Patel: PR updated: bumped focus ring to 3px, switched primary bg to #0f2b66, added `--spacing-compact` and `row-height-compact`, and default toast duration set to 6000ms. CI flagged one visual diff in button hover — asking design to confirm.
Iris Chen: Reviewing the visual diff now. If hover needs a slightly lighter bg, I prefer `primary-500` -> `primary-600` on hover. Will drop a quick Figma screenshot with exact hexes.
Leo Grant: Quick implementation note — compact spacing will affect table cell truncation; we should test with long job names and tokenized badges. I'll run layout regression locally after the CSS merge.
Marta Ruiz: Thanks — once Samir's PR lands, can we run axe scan on the new components in staging? Also request keyboard-only pass before rollout.
Samir Patel: Yep. Will add staging PR and tag @Marta for axe run.
Iris Chen: Awesome. Thanks everyone. I'll post the updated spec and screenshots here in the thread when ready. :thumbsup:
